machine.name: THE STING
machine.notes: Trigger state. A suspicious look lands. Valence drops (it hurts), arousal climbs (vigilance), dominance collapses (their verdict feels like it owns me). FIRST OPERATION: locate yourself. Not 'I feel bad' - name the components: hurt + vigilance + helplessness. A located state is already a smaller state.

ignatian.name: THE WOUND OF SUSPICION
ignatian.notes: To be suspected while innocent is an old station. Ignatius himself was repeatedly investigated - Alcala, Salamanca, Paris - and answered calmly each time, without bitterness, and kept walking. Begin the Examen here: name the wound honestly before God. Honesty about the sting is not weakness; pretending it does not hurt is the first false move.

scientific.name: SOCIAL-EVALUATIVE THREAT
scientific.notes: Acute response to perceived negative evaluation: negative valence, elevated arousal, external locus of control. Affect labeling at this stage measurably downregulates the response (Lieberman et al., 2007). Record antecedent precisely: WHAT was observed (a look, a tone) vs. what was INFERRED (their verdict). Keep observation and inference in separate columns.

machine.name: THE SPIRAL
machine.notes: The danger coordinate. Rumination: replaying looks, mind-reading verdicts, rehearsing defenses to a jury that never convenes. Every loop drops valence and dominance further. SORTING OPERATION: these thoughts are VECTORS, not facts. 'They all think I am bad' points to (-8,+8,-9). Classify it by where it carries you, not by how true it feels - feelings of certainty peak exactly here.

ignatian.name: DESOLATION SPEAKS
ignatian.notes: In desolation the enemy argues like a prosecutor: 'they see what you really are.' Rule 5 of the First Week: IN DESOLATION, NEVER REVISE A JUDGMENT MADE IN CONSOLATION. You knew your own goodwill yesterday; desolation has presented no new evidence, only new darkness. Do not re-litigate your character at midnight. Rule 8: this passes, though it swears it will not.

scientific.name: RUMINATIVE LOOP
scientific.notes: Self-referential threat rehearsal: mind-reading (inferring hostile cognition without data) and personalization (their suspicion as a fact about ME rather than their priors). Their suspicion is largely a function of THEIR base rates and history - data about the observer, not the observed. Rumination maintains arousal and deepens helplessness; the loop is the pathology, not the trigger.

machine.name: THE TURN
machine.notes: Waypoint, not destination. Still uncomfortable - but the DECOUPLING operation is engaging: the glance still fires, the displacement shrinks. Practice: when the look lands, breathe once, label it ('a glance is a glance - their inference, not my essence'), and let the wave pass WITHOUT acting on it or arguing with it. You are not yet calm. You are no longer commanded. Z crosses zero here - the hinge of the whole trajectory.

ignatian.name: AGERE CONTRA
ignatian.notes: Act against the pull. The desolation says: withdraw, defend, grow cold toward them. Agere contra says: be openly, simply good toward them precisely now - not to win the verdict, but because goodwill is who you are and was never theirs to confiscate. Note the paradox of the Freedom axis: you regain agency by RELEASING the demand to be vindicated. Honor or dishonor - indifferent to both, says the Principle and Foundation.

scientific.name: DEFUSION POINT
scientific.notes: Cognitive defusion engaging: thought observed as thought ('I am having the thought that they distrust me') rather than fused as fact. Reattribution: their suspicion explained by their history, incomplete information, and base rates - none of which you control, all of which are their variables. Locus of control begins shifting internal. Expect oscillation; the curve back to baseline is not monotonic.

machine.name: STEADY
machine.notes: Inside the target region. VALUE ANCHORING holds it: the question is no longer 'what do they think of me' but 'who am I regardless of audience.' Conduct is calibrated against the anchored values, not against their faces. Their suspicion may persist; it no longer sets your coordinates. SIMULATION maintains it: rehearse the next encounter in imagination - see the look, feel the small flare, stay in the body, respond as the anchored self.

ignatian.name: PEACE WITHOUT VINDICATION
ignatian.notes: True consolation does not require acquittal. Ignatius left his trials without demanding apology and without carrying the prosecutors in his heart. The test of this peace (Second Week, Rule 4): trace its trajectory - it ends in charity toward the suspicious, not contempt for them. If your calm curdles into 'they are beneath my notice,' it was false consolation wearing peace as a costume.

scientific.name: SET-POINT, INTERNALIZED LOCUS
scientific.notes: Return to home region: mild positive valence, mid-band arousal, solid dominance. Maintained by values-congruent behavior (commitment side of ACT) and scheduled imaginal rehearsal of evaluative situations - controlled exposure preventing re-sensitization. Outcome variable is NOT others' opinion (uncontrolled) but your displacement-per-trigger (controlled, measurable, shrinking).

machine.name: UNSHAKEN (CHECK THIS POINT)
machine.notes: The endpoint you asked for: their opinion means nothing. PLOTTED WITH A WARNING. Healthy detachment = their verdict no longer commands your state. But 'all opinions mean nothing' drifts toward the NUMBNESS coordinate - social signal fully muted is a sensor failure, not strength. The calibration: feedback from people who know you and wish you well still registers; suspicion from strangers operating on bad priors does not. Keep the antenna; change what it is tuned to.

ignatian.name: HOLY INDIFFERENCE (NOT CONTEMPT)
ignatian.notes: Indiferencia is freedom FROM the verdict, never coldness toward the people. The same Foundation that releases you from their dishonor binds you to their good. Discernment check: if this point ever feels like superiority, you have wandered toward pride wearing detachment's clothes - examine the movement's end. The truly free man can still be corrected by a friend; only the proud man cannot.

scientific.name: CALIBRATED AUTONOMY
scientific.notes: Differentiated social referencing: high dominance with selective, not absent, sensitivity to evaluation. Total insensitivity to social feedback predicts poor outcomes (it removes error-correction); the adaptive profile weights feedback by source reliability and goodwill. Slight negative arousal here is correct - this is a restful state, not an excited one. Maintain via periodic re-measurement: plot yourself after the next incident and compare displacement.
